fields.label: Type
fields.description: What kind of evidence this rung asks for. Sign-off means a competency attested by somebody senior rather than a course or a ticket.

fields.label: Course
fields.description: The course, or the course whose sign-off is being asked for.

fields.label: Credential
fields.description: An external ticket -- a licence, a card, a medical.

fields.label: Required
fields.description: Unticked means it counts toward readiness but does not block. Most things here are required; a few are 'would be good'.

fields.label: Note
fields.description: Why this rung asks for it. Read by whoever is deciding a promotion, so write it for them.
